issues.t: CloudTrail trail referenced-resource refusals diverge: wrong error class for an absent KMS key, re-worded log-group/SNS/KMS refusal texts, KmsKeyId echoed un-normalized, and InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException served 403

PutEventSelectors advanced-event-selector validation: the missing-eventCategory refusal uses an emulator-authored sentence, and the field-name/category, empty-operator, eventCategory-cardinality and resources.type rules
CloudTrail event-history read path: LookupEvents 400 bodies carry no Message, a lookup AWS answers 200 is refused, and ListPublicKeys serves one synthetic key
cloudtrail: 2 net-new root causes — PutEventSelectors' invalid-DataResources.Type refusal message is re-worded, and a logging trail still delivers no log file to its S3 bucket
CloudTrail request validation gaps: unchecked S3 bucket and insights window accept calls AWS refuses, and two rejection messages diverge
CloudTrail never rejects an unknown trail: lifecycle and selector operations return success, and TrailNotFoundException echoes a resolved ARN instead of the requested name
CloudTrail LookupEvents rejection messages use a generic constraint-violation template instead of AWS's fixed per-error text (4 causes)
cloudtrail: 2 net-new root causes — no management event is recorded for a read-only or refused CloudTrail call, and ListTrails is never authorized (an unprivileged IAM user is served 200)

CloudTrail event history records nothing for read-only or STS calls, returns an empty Events list over the whole retention window, never matches the ResourceName lookup attribute, and PutEventSelectors accepts a selector
DeleteDashboard refuses a termination-protected dashboard with its own invented message instead of AWS's fixed sentence
UpdateDashboard never advances DashboardStatus out of CREATED, so GetDashboard never reports UPDATING/UPDATED (1 cause)
CreateChannel misclassifies a non-ARN Destination Location as EventDataStoreARNInvalidException instead of InvalidParameterException
UpdateEventDataStore's "no mutable field supplied" refusal uses a non-AWS message (and is not reported as AWS words it)

CloudTrail page-size and query-id refusals diverge: LookupEvents refuses an over-maximum MaxResults instead of clamping, GetQueryResults answers the wrong error class, CancelQuery/DescribeQuery resolve the store before t
CloudTrail accepts three calls real AWS refuses: CreateEventDataStore, PutInsightSelectors on an unpolicied bucket, and UpdateTrail after the bucket policy is revoked

CloudTrail control-plane fidelity: GetTrailStatus omits its deprecated String members, ListTags and LookupEvents enforce limits AWS does not, Lake query/event-config refusals use the wrong code, an omitted tag Value is d
CloudTrail refusal fidelity: wrong error codes for selectors and event configuration, and refusal messages that do not follow AWS's request-derived templates

CloudTrail has no UpdateTrail concurrency control, CloudFormation never provisions AWS::CloudTrail::Trail, authorization is never evaluated, and the Lake/channel/import surface plus S3 DeleteBucketPolicy answer NotImplem
CloudTrail dashboard termination protection is dropped and PutResourcePolicy always answers ConflictException
CloudTrail CreateTrail/UpdateTrail skip every referenced-resource and selector validation and normalize KmsKeyId away
